newsitem.title: UK: UK BSE slaughter backlog to end within weeks - Hogg.
newsitem.headline: UK BSE slaughter backlog to end within weeks - Hogg.

text.p: The backlog in the scheme to slaughter cattle aged 30 months or over to tackle "mad cow" disease will be cleared within weeks, Agriculture Minister Douglas Hogg said on Wednesday.

"As from Monday, only registered animals will be taken under the scheme until the backlog is substantially cleared, which should be in early December in most parts of the United Kingdom," Hogg said in a statement.
He said some 55,000 animals a week are now being culled under the scheme. Ministry sources said almost 252,000 cattle had been killed up to November 5. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
